question: Why is the descent of power said to have a ninefold arrangement?
premises: The descent of power is taught here as ninefold.
If it were otherwise, one would have to attribute attachment or aversion to the Lord.
The Lord has no attachment or aversion anywhere.
inference: The ninefold arrangement of the descent of power explains its variation without attributing passion to the Lord.
plain_english: For this reason the descent of power is said here to have a ninefold arrangement; otherwise the Lord would have attachment or aversion somewhere, which he does not.
